a.smokebox_answer: NO double count. The 16,657 kg base has no separate smokebox item: SB-1 body/shell 1,900 = L3 3 mm hood 898 + ~1,002 cab/front, and that ~1,000 kg is already removed in full with the L3 cab (CAB-L3-REMOVE). The L3 smokebox front left the ledger with it, and there is no 150 kg placeholder inside the PE figure. So the 227.9 kg counts IN FULL (Loco Bot netted only +77.9 over a placeholder: 150 kg x 2.13 front share = +320 kg more on the front truck than Loco Bot carried). Residual: the removed ~1,000 kg was located at the cab CG X9350; if part of it really sat at the smokebox, the front truck is slightly lighter than computed (conservative for K2-a, unconservative for adhesion by < 1 %). Weigh-in governs.
